method: Each animation was generated as one horizontal strip on a transparent background, then sliced into 256x256 frames. Every strip after idle also used the approved idle-1 frame as a reference to keep the design consistent.
assumptions: The >_ glyph on Codex-Chan's hairclip is part of her design and is the only lettering allowed.
Nothing is drawn on Codex-Chan's laptop screen.
The hand or cursor holding the collar in the held frames is not drawn.
Sitting and landing poses are shorter without shrinking the head.
post_processing: System.Drawing: slice each strip into equal cells, drop detached alpha specks under 32 px, keep the generated alpha (no chroma key), bicubic downscale with one scale per animation, centre on a transparent 256x256 canvas with the lowest visible pixel at y=244. Alpha below 12 is cleared and alpha of 245 or more is made opaque. On 2026-10-23, larger detached slivers of neighbouring strip cells were removed (see review.json).
